# GymPropel

> Gym marketing agency for gym owners across North America. We run Facebook and Instagram ads (plus Google ads
> where local search demand fits), automated lead follow-up and websites as one system, and report on members who sign and stay (retention at
> month 3 and month 6), not lead counts. First month free, no contracts.

Contact: vincent@gympropel.com
Founder: Vincent Yu
Site: https://gympropel.com

## The offer

- First month free (30 days). No contracts, no deposits, no upfront costs. Month to month after that.
- Our fee in the free month is $0. The gym pays its own ad spend, straight to the platform (we never touch it or mark it up), plus minimal texting (SMS) costs.
- Cancel any time by text, email or phone. The ad account stays the gym's own (we work in it with partner access), and the website is usually the gym's to keep.
- One gym per market: we never work for your competitor.
- You deal with the founder, Vincent Yu, directly, not an account manager.
- Typical results once running: 5 to 15 new members per month, and the first new member in about 5 days.
- Free 30-minute call with Vincent on Google Meet, no card needed. If we can't help your gym, we'll tell you on the call: https://gympropel.com/book/

## Who it is for

Gym owners with an existing member base who can fund their own ad spend, in a market where nobody already works
with GymPropel. For very small gyms, paid ads may not be the bottleneck; we will say so on the call.

## Services

- [Gym Marketing Services: Ads, Follow-Up, Websites](https://gympropel.com/services/): Gym marketing services that turn strangers into members: Meta and Google ads, lead follow-up, automation, sign-ups, SEO and websites. First month free.
- [Gym Facebook Ads: Meta Campaigns for Gyms](https://gympropel.com/services/meta-ads/): We run gym Facebook ads and Instagram campaigns aimed at a real driving radius, then hand every lead to follow-up that answers in minutes. No contract.
- [Google Ads for Gyms: Search Campaigns](https://gympropel.com/services/google-ads/): Google Ads for gyms, built around the people already searching for a gym near them. Tight local keywords, tracked calls, and follow-up that answers fast.
- [Gym Lead Follow-Up: Speed to Lead, Done for You](https://gympropel.com/services/lead-follow-up/): Gym lead follow-up that answers every inquiry in minutes by text, email and voicemail, then keeps going for weeks. Built, written and monitored by us.
- [Gym Marketing Automation, Built and Run for You](https://gympropel.com/services/automation/): Gym marketing automation that runs in the background: your CRM pipeline, workflows and reactivation, built and monitored for you so no lead slips.
- [Gym Membership Sign-Ups: From Booked to Signed](https://gympropel.com/services/sign-ups/): More gym membership sign-ups from the leads you already get: reminders so intros show up, an intro built to sell, and a clear path from booked to signed.
- [Gym SEO: Get Found on Google Search and Maps](https://gympropel.com/services/seo/): Gym SEO for owners who want to show up when locals search for a gym near them: Google Business Profile, local pages and site fixes that compound over time.
- [Gym Website Design Built to Book Intros](https://gympropel.com/services/websites/): Gym website design that loads fast on a phone and does one job: turn a visitor into a booked intro. Built, written and wired to your CRM. Usually yours to keep.

## Client results

As reported by each gym owner:

- CrossFit Prior Lake (Prior Lake, MN), owner Josh: 81 to 132 members; 6 PT clients and 5 members in the first week. https://gympropel.com/case-studies/crossfit-prior-lake/
- HIITCore Fitness, owner Carlos: $1.1K+ collected in his first week of launch.
- MUV The Gym, owner Jose: $4.2K in new memberships in his first 40 days.
- ION Strength & Conditioning, owner Jeremy: 5 new memberships and 20 appointments in 15 days.
- Puravida Fitness, owner Erik P.: about 10 high-value members in one month (approximate).
- CrossFit Shelby, owner Will B.: 61 to 72 members in one month.

All results: https://gympropel.com/case-studies/
